text: ともしびやまが　さいごに　ふんか　したのは…　いつ　だったかしらねえ

structure.jp: ともしびやまが　さいごに　ふんか　したのは…
structure.en: the last time Mt. Ember erupted...

structure.jp: いつ　だったかしらねえ

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb makes the whole happening into a thing to talk about; here it stands for 'the time'. ふんか　したのは = 'the time it erupted was...'

patterns.name: 〜かしら
patterns.span: いつ　だったかしら
patterns.explanation: かしら at the end means 'I wonder', mostly in women's speech. いつ　だったかしら = 'when was it, I wonder'.
